suitableFor: related-articles / 'up next' lists at the end of an article
compact text-only link lists with a title and a supporting date/label
no-image card lists where the whole item links out
notSuitableFor: image + title + description teaser grids (use cards-teaser)

usage.note: No-images cards variant for the magazine article 'up next' related-stories list (title + date). Distinct from cards-teaser, which is an image-heavy spacious teaser grid (similarity to cards-teaser ~20%, below the 80% reuse threshold).
